objectives: To systematically review and meta-analyse how smoking behaviour affects tuberculosis incidence, specifically the association between smoking and TB risk in Chinese populations.
inclusion_criteria: Eligible studies were conducted in Chinese populations (in China or among Chinese populations abroad), included adults aged 18 years or older regardless of TB status, reported original research data, examined smoking behaviour as the exposure, evaluated active TB incidence/outcomes, and reported TB incidence data with or without demographic or clinical stratification. Eligible designs included prospective or observational cohort studies, randomised or experimental studies, cross-sectional studies, retrospective cohort studies, and case-control studies.
exclusion_criteria: Excluded were reviews, commentaries, case reports, and other inappropriate designs; studies in non-Chinese populations; studies not evaluating smoking as the exposure; studies without a clearly defined TB outcome; studies lacking an appropriate comparator group; studies with inaccessible full text; and studies with insufficient outcome data.
pmid_query: ("tuberculosis"[Title/Abstract] OR "TB"[Title/Abstract] OR "Mycobacterium tuberculosis"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("smoking"[Title/Abstract] OR "cigarette"[Title/Abstract] OR "tobacco use"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("China"[Title/Abstract] OR "Chinese"[Title/Abstract])
selection_evidence: PRISMA/Figure 1 reports 29 studies in the systematic review and 23 studies in the meta-analysis. Table 1 lists 29 included studies; six rows have NA in the OR/HR column (Tsai 2016, Bai 2016, Ma 2019, Tse 2018, Cao 2025, Lin 2008), leaving 23 studies with quantitative effect estimates. Figure 3 confirms quantitative synthesis with 17 OR entries and 7 HR entries. However, the manuscript's citation numbering is internally inconsistent across Table 1, Results, and the reference list (including mismatches/duplications around refs [7], [19]/[41], and [35]/[43]), so exact ref-number extraction is not defensible from the staged materials.
